newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TVK share buyback seen boosting price - CSFB.
newsitem.headline: TVK share buyback seen boosting price - CSFB.

text.p: The shares of Hungarian chemicals maker Tiszai Vegyi Kombinat Rt (TVK) are set to rise further on the back of a 2.8 million share buyback by the company, CS First Boston said on Wednesday.
"TVK (is) our top medium-term pick on the Hungarian market and in the eastern European chemical sector," CSFB analyst Spencer Jakab said in a company update.
TVK has recently confirmed that it had bought back 2.8 million shares but gave no details of either the price or the identity of the seller. @

"It is clearly connected to the sale by the Tiszaujvaros municipality of its large stake in the company three weeks ago," Jakab said, adding that "the news of the buyback will spark a further rally in the stock in coming days".
He said that while the stock has appreciated 19.7 percent over the last month in dollar terms, "we see continued upside over the next four to six months of 33 percent".
CSFB maintained its earlier "buy" recommendation for TVK.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, TVK shares closed at 1,635 forints, up 5.
